messages:
Jamal K: hey all, new hire here — trying to get access to Datadog logs + Grafana dashboards for the inference runtime. followed the onboarding doc but hitting 403 when opening /dashboards. anyone who can add me to the observability groups? my SSO is jamal@redwood.ai

devex-bot: welcome @Jamal K! please ping #devex with your SSO and which projects you need access to. quicklinks: https://internal.redwood/docs/observability-onboard :wave:

Maria D: @Jamal K send your email — i can add you to Grafana viewers and the Datadog team. which Grafana folder/dashboard do you need? and Sentry project name?

Jamal K: thanks @Maria D — email is jamal@redwood.ai. primary needs: "inference-runtime latency" dashboard and the logs for inference-runtime-prod. Sentry project maybe "inference-runtime-prod" (not 100% on slug).

Alex R: hey @Jamal K i can help with Datadog. 403 usually means SSO group provisioning didn't finish or you need the org-level role. try an incognito sign-in first. if still 403 i'll add you to the redwood-observability group.

Alex R: also sending the quick curl check in case you want to test auth:

```
curl -v -H "DD-API-KEY: <redacted>" "https://api.datadoghq.com/api/v1/logs-queries/list" 
# replace with your workspace token; if you get 403 it's an auth problem
```

Maria D: added @Jamal K to grafana-viewers and the grafana folder readers. try https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/inference-runtime

Jamal K: grafana access works now :tada: — can see the latency panels. datadog logs still 403 when I open the log explorer.

Alex R: i poked SCIM / provisioning and forced a sync for jamal@redwood.ai. should propagate in ~2-5m. keep me posted.

SRE Oncall: fyi we had a provisioning quirk this morning where non-admins in certain AD groups were getting blocked on logs read — fixed in the identity service. if it's still an issue i'll temp-add you to the datadog-readers role.

Jamal K: confirmed — datadog works now. thanks everyone! quick follow-up: who owns the inference-runtime dashboards if i want to tweak a panel?

Maria D: ownership is the infra-observability group and @ing-platform handles dashboard PRs. for small edits ping me and i'll do a quick update. for larger changes open a PR with the exported grafana JSON in the dashboards repo.

Jamal K: perfect. appreciate the fast help :heart: — closing this thread.
